description: LEGACY platform (archived from mega_cruise_5000, Feb 2026). Berthing is represented as 27 large well-mixed passenger cabin blocks (~200 occupants each) and 4 crew-quarter blocks. Each block models direct contact as if all occupants share an open ward, so cabin confinement and quarantine protocols do not isolate agents from their block-mates or the full HVAC-linked population. Retained for regression and comparison only; use mega_cruise_5000 for cabin-corridor resolution (see docs/PLATFORM_CABIN_REVISION.md).
